incidents: Initial Linux staging archive omitted a developer dependency and two fixture paths; original full run 2374 pass /3 fixture-load failures/1 skip retained; affected files then 12/12 pass.
Initial upload preceded directory creation; a subsequent tar extraction rejected existing directory entries. File-only unlink extraction completed the isolated fixture; live manifest remained exact.
First browser fixtures lacked account initialization, then release-notes popup raced the click. Fixtures corrected; final 18 cases passed.
Staging source guard initially rejected Git export CRLF vs committed LF. Exact SHA after EOL normalization matched all three backend sources; guard retained.
Initial 60-player soak failed at PostgreSQL initialization before load. Repeated 60+5 ten-minute run passed; 90+5 failed all three frequency windows. Negative evidence retained.
Preopen was attempted before cold startup completed and received ECONNREFUSED. No entry was opened; the ready/PG guards then passed and full verification was repeated.

First calendar proof matched every field except revision (+2 actual versus +1 expected). WAL showed separate expiry of an old notice and a waiting quest chest. Verifier had omitted an earlier notice deadline; corrected to replay both deadlines and retained the failed proof.
